title: Lance Roberts: Margin Liquidation, Not Structural Breakdown

excerpts.label: Margin liquidation drove selloff, not fundamentals
excerpts.insight: Stellar GOOGL/AMZN earnings met with selling because leveraged positions needed collateral. Headlines were rationalization, not cause.
excerpts.pm_takeaway: BUY beaten-down mega-caps. Margin calls forced selling despite 0.5 PEG ratios and stellar earnings. Entry opportunity created by technical liquidation, not fundamental deterioration.

excerpts.label: Margin debt creates domino risk across assets
excerpts.insight: Crypto, metals, equities all triggered simultaneous margin calls. Highly correlated assets become uncorrelated under stress.
excerpts.pm_takeaway: HEDGE via diversification won't work when correlations go to one. Use hard stops (100-day MA) not asset class rotation to manage leverage-driven drawdowns.

excerpts.label: Value rotation exhausted—growth setup
excerpts.insight: Value vs growth ratio hit weekly overbought extreme. MGK touched 200-day MA. Factor model flipped 80% growth Tuesday (18 indicators unanimous).
excerpts.pm_takeaway: ROTATE to mega-cap growth NOW. Factor model says 23-435 day outperformance window just opened. Value exhausted after January run.

excerpts.label: Reflation narrative at risk
excerpts.insight: Employment weak (20-30K jobs), wage growth declining, 3.5% savings rate contradicts surge. 70% of GDP is consumption—how does 15% capex drive growth?
excerpts.pm_takeaway: FADE reflation trades. Industrials, materials, energy ran hard in January and priced in narrative before data confirms. Sell rallies in these sectors.

excerpts.label: Truflation shows sharp disinflation
excerpts.insight: Truflation (tracks million prices real-time) dropped like a rock last 1.5 months. High correlation with CPI/PCE suggests reflation narrative has problem.
excerpts.pm_takeaway: Watch CPI/PCE next prints. If Truflation correlation holds, disinflation incoming contradicts reflation thesis. Validates fading industrials/materials/energy.

excerpts.label: Credit spreads at 20-year lows
excerpts.insight: AAA to junk all compressed at lowest levels in 20 years. 15 years of Fed bailouts taught markets there's no risk in taking risk.
excerpts.pm_takeaway: Watch credit spreads daily—not headlines. Compressed levels mean patience (no systemic alarm yet), but widening like 2007/2017-18 = first warning. Track, don't trade.

excerpts.label: Factor rotation model flipped to growth
excerpts.insight: 18 indicators flipped Tuesday: 80% value → 20% value, 80% growth. Rotations last 23 days to 435 days historically.
excerpts.pm_takeaway: Growth outperforms next. Duration unknown (23-435 days) but signal clear. Load mega-caps (GOOGL, AMZN, NVDA) that just corrected on margin liquidation.
